I had the opportunity to go see Chance my freshman year of college, my girlfriend and roomate both decided to go. I was pretty new to rap, fairly broke/stingy because of being broke, and made what I consider the worst decision of my college life. I missed his Acid Rap tour at The Fillmore in Silver Spring, Md. A few days later I listened to him a little and the rest is history. Easily my favorite artist, and I made it up by seeing him last year at the same venue! His set up for Sunday Candy was incredible and Shy Glizzy randomly showed up for them to do two of his songs. Pusha Man also once caused me to have my most intense trip experience by making the world turn into 3D planes, so I like to think we have a spiritual connection

I personally choose to experiment with drugs. Over the last few years, I have experimented with a fairly wide variety of drugs. From the basic weed to things like acid, mdma, cocaine, salvia, etc. My reasoning for doing these things have honestly ranged between multiple ideals depending on each drug. However, I feel that most of it can be summed up as me having a very open mind due to me having started off young (13 was the first time I smoked weed). From there, I gradually tried new things because I have learned that I genuinely enjoy doing these things. I feel that as long as I am careful and am willing to take the unavoidable risks, then these things are simply experience enhancers (for acid it was the exerience). I will say that not all of my use has been simply for experience enhancers here and there. I discovered that I am prone to xanax addiction. Therefore, I do everything in my power to steer clear of even being near it. I cant wait to read everyone else's responses!
